'''Tera''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked as a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] with the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Kasso Trelek]] and the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[N1-FEX]]. On one occasion the group traveled to a [[Unidentified cantina (Grogen's territory)|cantina]] within the territory of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Grogen]]. Once seated, Tera and her companions were served [[Lum/Legends|Lum]] [[Ale/Legends|ale]]. The criminal [[Vols]] approached Tera and threatened her. Tera called the droid, after which he produced a [[Light repeating blaster/Legends|light repeating blaster]] from his heavy carrying case and open fire, destroying much of the bar and [[Death/Legends|killing]] a number of the thugs with Vols. After Kasso threw a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] into the fight from the [[Refresher/Legends|refresher]], the thugs and other patrons of the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] fled, followed shortly after by Tera and her companions once they realized the detonator was not a decoy. The explosion destroyed the cantina, flinging a [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] spike through one of Fex's [[Limb/Legends|legs]]. The trio then fled for the nearest [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]].<ref name="Dangerous Covenants" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tera appears in the opening story in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook ''[[Dangerous Covenants]]''.
